name: pubquiz-player
description: PubQuiz Player: the optional phone app for PubQuiz teams (Android and iOS, Capacitor)

scripts.android:debug: node scripts/build-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: node scripts/build-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios: node scripts/build-web.mjs && cap sync ios && cap open ios
